Riptide Tavern, inspired by owner Tim Spinner's Jersey Shore childhood, will open at 4388 Main Street in Manayunk with a 38-seat, beach-themed interior. The bar will feature a no-cell-phone policy, a jukebox stocked with pre-2004 albums, and a cocktail program centered on citrus crushes and signature drinks.

Fat + Flour's Grand Central Market outpost is closing after nearly seven years in operation, as announced on social media on May 15. The Culver City location at 11739 W. Washington Blvd. will continue to operate.

Milkshake Factory is set to open a new location at The Commons at Hamilton Quarter near New Albany and Gahanna in Columbus. No confirmed opening date has been announced by the Pittsburgh-based brand. The concept is known for handcrafted milkshakes, sundaes, and chocolate treats made with premium ingredients.

Mediterranean restaurant Mozaika Mezze is planning a new Buckhead location at the former Alma Cocina space in Terminus 100, with signage indicating a fall opening. The restaurant draws together Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese flavors with mezze, pide, and wood-grilled skewers. It will join an existing Alpharetta location that opened last August.

Carolina Smash Truck, a Charlotte-area food truck known for gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches, will permanently close on May 23, 2026, after nine years in business. The owners announced the closure via social media without providing a specific reason. The truck served customers across Charlotte, Concord, and the Lake Norman area.

Fish and Bird Sousaku Izakaya will close on June 14, 2026, after a 6.5-year run on Shattuck Avenue in Berkeley. The owner cited retirement and other factors behind the decision, and the restaurant will remain open Thursdays through Mondays until its final day. The Japanese restaurant is known for its traditional menu made with locally sourced ingredients.

The building was sold in February 2026 for $5.9 million and new owners plan to move forward with their own concept. The team explored relocation options but was unable to find a suitable new site.

data.location: 58 The Esplanade, Toronto, ON M5E 1R2, Canada

Developed by brothers Graham and Dan Hnatiw, the venue will accommodate roughly 700 guests indoors and up to 1,000 with the patio. The concept will feature line dancing, live music, pizza, and a cocktail program.

data.location: 3005 Old Alabama Rd, Johns Creek, GA 30022

The team behind Aged & Infused is debuting a new cocktail bar called Home Bar at the former Rhine Hall Distillery space at 2010 W Fulton Street, with hopes for a mid-July opening. No official opening date has been announced, as the owners are still awaiting licensing approval. The bar will serve martinis and cocktails featuring flavors from the Aged & Infused product line.

data.location: 1693 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6K 1V2, Canada
data.short_description: Buon Riso, a Roman-style supplì concept from chef Kaitlyn Lasagna, will launch a pop-up residency at Pasta Forever beginning June 14, with pre-orders expected to open the Monday before launch. Heart Attack Grill, located inside Neonopolis Mall in Downtown Las Vegas, announced it will not renew its long-term lease after nearly 15 years, citing changes in the dining landscape, rising costs, and shifting customer habits. The team indicated this is not a final goodbye and described the closure as "the beginning of a new chapter." The hospital-themed restaurant first launched in Arizona in 2005 before relocating to Las Vegas in 2011.

Lighthouse Kitchen and Cafe, a 24-hour cafe inspired by owner Claudia Vazquez's Mexican roots, is coming soon to 3109 Pacific Ave. in Wildwood. The cafe will grind and brew all coffee in-house using beans from the owner's family farm in Chiapas, Mexico. The menu will feature all-day breakfast, brunch, dinner, and a signature item called the "machete," a long quesadilla filled with meat and Oaxaca cheese.

data.location: 301 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

The concept is led by co-founders David Cross and Rebeca Cross alongside a founding team that first worked together 14 years ago. The business plans to build a diverse team that includes individuals of all abilities alongside experienced hospitality professionals.

data.status: expected to open in early June

The eatery will offer customizable Mediterranean bowls, wraps, and salads, taking over the former For the Love of Dough Cookies space. It marks the second new vendor to join Little Grand Market in 2026.

Coastal Canteen, a new concept from the Jersey Shore Restaurant Group, is coming to 142 Main Street in Manasquan with no official opening date yet announced. Chef Andre Barbero will lead the culinary program, offering coastal-inspired dishes with locally sourced ingredients including a raw bar, shareables, handhelds, and entrees. The restaurant's Instagram indicated it is "almost there."

Tigris, a Hi-Fi Listening Bar, is slated to open soon at 2545 Bagley Street in Southwest Detroit, featuring a custom sound system designed by Detroit-based Bing Audio and an eclectic vinyl library. The venue will offer a Middle Eastern-inspired cocktail menu with light fare and non-alcoholic options, functioning as a café by day and an intimate cocktail bar by night. The project is a collaboration between Music Supervisor Fabian Halabou, Inlaws Hospitality, and Kenan Juska.

The Daily Nosh is preparing to open on June 8 in Downtown Roseville at 105 Vernon Street, after receiving liquor license approval. Co-owners David and Lisa Peters will offer scratch-made breakfast and lunch in a historic 1957 building originally constructed as a Pontiac dealership. The restaurant is currently hiring staff ahead of its opening.

The restaurant will serve signature smashburgers, truffle fries, chicken bites, and milkshakes, mirroring the menu at their existing Shelby Township location.

SoMa Social opened on May 15, 2026 in San Francisco's South of Market neighborhood as a sports bar offering breakfast, lunch, dinner, happy hour, and late-night drinks. Created by Oxford Hotels & Resorts LLC, the venue features vintage sports-inspired décor, wall-to-wall TVs, and a semi-private lounge called The Huddle Lounge. It is part of the ongoing revitalization of San Francisco's Mid-Market district.

Claude's Comedy Club & Bar, owned by Reid Benditt, is set to open at 1123 S. Broad Street in Philadelphia. The venue will feature a bar area open without a ticket and an adjacent intimate showroom for stand-up comedy. The menu will offer shareable finger foods, cocktails, and beer in a diner-meets-bar atmosphere.

data.short_description: La Grullensa, a family-owned Mexican restaurant in East San Jose, will serve its final meal on May 24 and close its doors on May 25, 2026 after more than 35 years in business. The restaurant team shared an emotional farewell message on Instagram expressing gratitude to the community.

PopUp Bagels is opening its second San Diego County location at 510 Vista Way in Oceanside, operated by local franchise partners Paul Goodman and Griffin Thall, known as The Bagel Boyz. The opening celebration will be held on May 22, 2026 from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. and will feature a limited-time Blackberry Jalapeño Crunch Schmear created in partnership with Brian Malarkey.

Blue Collar, a comfort food restaurant located in Miami's MiMo district, officially closed its doors on May 17, 2026 after its final dinner service. Founded in 2012 by Chef Daniel Serfer, the restaurant was known for hearty American dishes, popular desserts, and a wide selection of vegetable sides. No specific reason for the closure was shared by the owner.

Fiorenza Italian is a new upscale yet casual Italian restaurant coming to Alpharetta, brought by Florence-raised restaurateur Jessi Qilafi. The restaurant will feature Tuscan dishes and house-made pastas including Pappardelle al Ragu, Pici Cacio e Pepe, and Bistecca alla Fiorentina. It aims to transport diners to Florence and serve as a neighborhood favorite.

The tasting room will be reservation-only at first to provide a direct, one-on-one hospitality experience.

CHICHA San Chen, an internationally renowned Taiwanese tea house, is opening its second Massachusetts location at One Brattle Square in Harvard Square. The upcoming shop follows the success of the brand's first Massachusetts location opened in 2024 at the Lyrik development in Boston's Back Bay. The menu will feature bubble teas, fruit teas, oolong teas, and cassia black teas made using tea leaves sourced from Taiwan's Lishan mountains.

Owner Adnan Alame also indicated interest in future Bay Area expansion into markets such as San Jose, Santa Clara, and Hayward.

Owner Cheung-Sang Chik noted the closure could be an opportunity to make changes to the space.

data.short_description: Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is gearing up to open a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse in Bastrop at a space that formerly housed Stem & Stone. Owner Robinson Figueiredo announced hiring for the new location, and a "coming soon" post indicates the space is in progress. The restaurant will serve authentic churrasco and Brazilian dishes.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease for a third location at 32500 Gratiot Avenue in Roseville, expanding its Metro Detroit presence beyond existing Detroit and White Lake locations. Owner Evan Shina does not have an opening date at this time. The restaurant serves savory tacos, burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and family trays with build-your-own options.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location on May 31, with the owner citing a desire to refocus on the original Spring Valley location. Owner Kerry Pauly shared an emotional announcement on social media thanking the community for its support over the years. The Spring Valley location will remain open and continue operating.

data.status: plans pointing to a later 2026 opening

The Winston-Salem restaurant adds to the company's growing North Carolina presence, with additional sites also planned for Concord and Raleigh. No specific opening date has been announced.

Ike's Café & Grill hosted a ribbon-cutting, open house, and community celebration on May 8 for its newest 3,200 sq. ft. restaurant in Marietta. The full-service restaurant serves African-inspired cuisine including smoky jollof rice, suya, egusi soup, grilled meats and fish, and specialty coffees. The new location is the brand's first full-service restaurant, expanding from its ghost kitchen concept launched in 2025.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy, announced its closure on social media on May 13 after five years of business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited economic struggles and the extreme overhead of running a small business as the reasons for closing. The shop was known for East Coast-style sandwiches and in-house prepared meats.

The brand aims to elevate rum's perception and appeal to consumers who typically favor tequila or other spirits.

Ted's Hot Dogs is opening its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026, featuring a retro-inspired design, a spacious outdoor patio, indoor gathering spaces, a walk-up ice cream window, and the brand's first drive-thru. The two-day grand opening celebration will include giveaways, a Golden Keychain for the first customer offering lifetime buy-one-get-one-free hot dogs, free T-shirts for the first 20 customers, and free hot dogs for the first 100 patrons. Founded in Buffalo, New York, in 1927, Ted's Hot Dogs is a fourth-generation family-owned chain.

Founded in 2011, Asian Box offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food made with fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients. The chain was founded by Chad Newton and chef Gracie Nguyen.

Ristobar, a longtime Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, is closing on May 25 (Memorial Day) after more than 22 years in operation. The restaurant team shared the closure on social media, noting the Chestnut Street space will continue operating as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq. ft. indoor-outdoor events venue through a partnership with Eria Events. No specific reason for closure was shared by the team.

Sushi Kobashi, led by chef Gang Lin who was part of the Michelin Star-winning team at Yoshino, is preparing to open an eight-seat omakase restaurant at 211 7th Ave. in Chelsea. The restaurant will offer classic sushi and sashimi a la carte, with an omakase experience starting at $250 per guest and a focus on premium sake. Lin plans to infuse the experience with Chinese ingredients in a nod to his heritage.

The hospitality team behind Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social is planning a new gastropub called Clarke & Moore Kitchen and Bar at 201 8th Ave. in Chelsea. The first floor will seat 49 guests for sit-down dining, while the second floor will serve as a private event space for up to 74 guests. No opening date has been announced.

The menu will reflect a New American point of view featuring prime beef, American wagyu, seafood, and sushi.

Lou Malnati's South Loop location has completed an approximately 2,400 sq. ft. expansion, bringing the restaurant to nearly 8,400+ square feet total. The updated space adds a new full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space accommodating up to 50 guests. The expansion was completed while the restaurant continued regular operations.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar is opening its second location at 110 Campus Way inside Campus 244's Element Hotel by Westin in Dunwoody on May 15, 2026. Co-owners include Charlie Sunyapong, Raquel Stalcup, Natalie Yeung, and Tola Mak.

data.short_description: C.R. Chicks has filed permit applications with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to open a location in the Wedgewood Commons Shopping Center in Stuart. No official opening date has been announced, and the location is confirmed on the C.R. Chicks website. The Florida-born rotisserie chicken chain was founded in 1992 and is known for fresh chicken roasted over Brazilian oak logs.

Sweet Melody, a Miami-born ice cream shop, announced its 5th location opening in Kendall's London Square. The shop will offer 16 flavors by the scoop, pints, milkshakes, and sundaes in its signature record store-meets-ice cream shop decor. Owner Mike Romeu started the business in 2019 and has been expanding rapidly, with a Fort Lauderdale location opening just a month prior.

data.status: shooting for an Oct. 1 opening date
data.short_description: A new donut shop called Uniontown Baking Company is planned for 264 W Marine Drive in Astoria, OR, in a former antique store space. It is being opened by local retiree Glenn Taggart, who hired chef Kurt Rummel for the menu. The shop will serve donut staples like fritters, long johns, and glazed options, with indoor seating available.

data.location: 344 Corey Ave, St Pete Beach, FL 33706
data.short_description: Fellas Vinoir is a European-style cafe and wine bar planning to open at 344 Corey Ave in St. Pete Beach. An owner named Konstantinos confirmed the opening but said it was too soon to share most details. The concept will feature breakfast by day and a wine-focused menu by night.

data.status: preparing to take the next step
data.short_description: Kareem's Lebanese Kitchen, an acclaimed Florida concept helmed by Chef Rachid Eido, is opening at 212 Boardwalk Place in Gaithersburg, MD, in a former Bach to Rock storefront. No official opening date has been announced, but a liquor license hearing with the Montgomery County Alcohol Beverage Services Board is scheduled for May 21. The menu will feature authentic Lebanese dishes including chicken farrouj and salmon harra.
